name: Lands of Fire
source:
Lands of Fire is a gay furry VN based on the cultures and oral traditions of pre-colonial Australia. 

Kubbadang, a Yuin thylacine, is tasked by his elders to bring warriors from Budj Bim in order to fight off the hordes of monsters sent by the Sun Woman, who seeks to devour all of humanity. Along for the ride are his sister Guddity, his childhood friends Winyu (a rakali) and Dhurra (a platypus), the Gamilaraay warrior Bangalaa (a sea eagle), the Arrernte kurdaitcha Perrurle (a kangaroo) and the mysterious medicine woman Bina (a goanna).

[From [url=https://landsoffire.wordpress.com/]WordPress[/url] and [url=https://mullerornis.itch.io/lands-of-fire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Lands of Fire》是一部以殖民前澳大利亚的文化与口述传统为基础的男同性恋兽人视觉小说。

尤因族袋狼Kubbadang受长老所托，前往布吉必姆招募战士，抵御太阳女派出的成群怪物，她企图吞噬全人类。同行者有他的妹妹Guddity、青梅竹马Winyu（一只澳洲水鼠）与Dhurra（一只鸭嘴兽），还有Gamilaraay族战士Bangalaa（一只海雕）、Arrernte族的库尔戴查巫师Perrurle（一只袋鼠），以及神秘的女巫医Bina（一只巨蜥）。

[摘自[url=https://landsoffire.wordpress.com/]WordPress[/url]与[url=https://mullerornis.itch.io/lands-of-fire]itch.io[/url]]
